description: One model call finished: its whole text and thinking, what it spent (`usage`, `turnCost`), how long it took (`wallMs`), why it stopped, and the step's RUNNING cost after it (`stepCost`). The page's cost counter moves on this event, and a reopened loop rebuilds the turn from it — the streamed `model.delta` chunks are not needed. Emitted even when the call failed part-way, because it still spent what it spent.

payload.text: Now let me measure the work.
payload.thinking: We need the toolchain versions first.
